ai.privacy: To suggest dashboards and spreadsheets, Sytue AI only sees what data exists — the field names — never the data itself. Each report is read with your permissions.

bank.howTo: How do I get the file from my bank?
bank.howToBody: In your bank’s online business banking, open the account, look for “Download transactions” or “Export” and choose the Norma 43 format (also called Cuaderno 43 or AEB 43). Every Spanish bank offers it. Upload it here once a week: whatever is already in is never duplicated.

bank.invoiceHint: If the invoice has several VAT rates or a withholding, create it in its list and then pick it with “Another invoice”.
bank.otherIncomeHint: If it is a sale (card payments, for example), add its invoice instead: otherwise it will not count in your taxes.
bank.subtitle: Every transaction in your bank needs its invoice or a reason. Sytue matches on its own whatever leaves no doubt; the rest waits here.
bank.title: Bank
bank.whoHint: If they are not in your contacts yet, type their name and they will be added.

vf.adminOnly: The organisation’s administrators can turn it on.
vf.allSent: Everything has been sent to the Tax Agency.
vf.confirmBody: From now on, every invoice you confirm is sent to the Spanish Tax Agency and can no longer be edited or deleted: mistakes are fixed with a corrective invoice. Once turned on, it stays on for the rest of the year.
vf.fixHint: Fix the invoice or customer details, then send it again.
vf.intro: From 2027 every invoice must be registered with the Spanish Tax Agency as soon as it is issued. With VERI*FACTU, Sytue does it for you when you confirm an invoice, and adds the QR code your customer can use to check it.
vf.reason.certificate: Not available yet on this Sytue: the certificate to file with the Tax Agency is missing.
vf.reason.country: Only for organisations based in Spain.
vf.reason.declaration: Not available yet: Sytue has not yet signed the declaration of conformity for this version.
vf.reason.foral: In the Basque Country and Navarre, invoices are registered with the regional tax office (TicketBAI), not with VERI*FACTU.
vf.reason.igic: Not available yet in the Canary Islands, Ceuta and Melilla, where invoices do not carry VAT.
vf.reason.profile: Complete the organisation profile (tax ID and postcode) to turn it on.
vf.reason.taxId: The organisation’s tax ID is not valid.
